_comment: Where content ideas come from. Defaults need no accounts. Where there's no API, the agent reads it in the browser — that's the normal path, not a workaround.

seo._subreddits_hint: Leave empty and the agent will find where your audience actually posts. Add them once you know.
seo._competitor_urls_hint: Pages you'd like to outrank. When set, these take priority over Reddit.
seo._paid_tools_hint: Only turn these on if you already pay for them. Never buy one for this.

linkedin._repurpose_hint: own_material is the day-one default. Prefer inputs/queue/ once engine-loop has filled it. One article is usually three or four posts.

video._footage_hint: Your own clips and product recordings first. Pexels is the safety net so a run always completes — not the default look.

outreach._research_hint: One real, recent, specific observation per person. If there's nothing to find, they're the wrong target.
